defects.title: STM unpacked in C order (Phi^T used for Phi)
defects.root_cause: nom48[:, 6:42] is column-major (order='F'); the analysis helper reshaped it row-major
defects.effect: R1O surrogate state Jacobians used the transpose of the STM; state columns wrong at O(1)
defects.repair: order='F' everywhere; HARDEN audit found 25 production/analysis reshape sites, all column-major; only 3 labelled defect-reproduction oracles use C order

defects.title: Earth ephemeris 504000 s early (epoch-origin mismatch)
defects.location: campaign Earth table (od_gravity_covariance_campaign.get_earth_pos, C.ET0 = phase7 ET0 - 504000 s) fed to the production range model whose Earth rotation uses et0
defects.root_cause: the Earth table and the measurement model counted seconds from different ET origins; the production generator accepted any Earth callable with no epoch metadata
defects.effect: Earth centre displaced by ~5.8 days of lunar orbital motion relative to the Earth rotation used for station placement; all range/ΔDOR geometry inconsistent
defects.repair: FXR: canonical epoch-tagged EarthEphemeris. HARDEN: lunar_od.measurement_contracts.generate_two_way_range_measurements_checked validates tagged providers (EphemerisEpochMismatchError) in front of the byte-frozen generator; scenarios.py and every Phase-17 builder use it (structural test); MoonCenteredEphemeris carries et0/frame/centre/units
defects.regression: tests/test_fxr_earth_epoch_fixture.py; tests/test_harden_mutants.py mutant A (+ physical SPICE oracle)

defects.title: Earth table clamped at 28260 s
defects.root_cause: out-of-coverage queries returned the last sample instead of raising
defects.effect: Earth frozen for every epoch after 28260 s of the arc (Earth moves ~1 km/s relative to the Moon)
defects.repair: FXR: canonical fixture raises EarthEphemerisCoverageError. HARDEN: production MoonCenteredEphemeris raises EphemerisCoverageError beyond a 10 s margin instead of PCHIP extrapolation
defects.regression: tests/test_harden_mutants.py mutant B; tests/test_harden_boundaries.py coverage tests

defects.title: ΔDOR / surrogate / Earth-LOS rows formed behind the Moon
defects.root_cause: each builder re-implemented visibility as an elevation mask only; the production elevation+occultation test existed but was not shared
defects.effect: 93 of 263 canonical ΔDOR rows (35%) and 230 of 590 Earth-LOS rows (39%) were physically impossible; R1O-D/FXR combined f_perp 0.3204 instead of 0.172351
defects.repair: single contract phase17_r1m_core.station_visibility_mask (production analyze_visibility_gap_with_transforms); every builder defaults to it; elevation-only survives only as an explicitly named, warning-emitting legacy rule
defects.regression: tests/test_harden_mutants.py mutant C (all builders + zero-radius mutant); tests/test_r1od2_ddor_contracts.py; tests/test_harden_boundaries.py limb/random-occultation oracles

defects.title: Range Jacobian: STM vs re-propagation discrepancy 1e-6..1e-4
defects.root_cause: the variational A matrix omits the SRP position gradient K*dg/dr (documented Phase 13/16 approximation, mean 4.02e-13 of the gravity gradient); the gradient is concentrated in penumbra (max 1.09e-11 s^-2, median 7.7e-19) and its effect accumulates secularly
defects.effect: range-Jacobian state columns relative error 2e-6..1e-5 over 4 orbits at rtol 1e-13; the event (light-time) derivative itself is exact (LIN error 1e-8..9e-8, falling with h)
defects.repair: Phase 17-F1 (commit 9a0e786, authorised protected change, additive R2 re-freeze 434b9c3): the exact position gradient of the production SRP force (distance, direction and penumbra-illumination terms) now enters the A matrix of every SRP-active variational path; the acceleration is unchanged (bitwise). Qualified: local gradient <= 1.5e-7 vs independent oracles in every regime; STM max best-resolved error 9.9e-8 (pre-F1 model 1.2e-6; fixed-step RK4 cross-check 2.2e-8 vs 3.4e-6); S_K 8.7e-7; all Phase-17 classes preserved (docs/phase17_f1_srp_variational_gradient_qualification.md). HARDEN history: none in HARDEN (dynamics.py was R2-protected). CLOSED as a mathematically understood, bounded approximation: NO_SHADOW and K=0 controls drop the error to the integrator floor; the first-order prediction from the omitted gradient reproduces all six columns (corr >= 0.986, residual <= 1.0e-7) once the FD oracle is integrated at rtol 3e-15. The partial fit at rtol 1e-14 (y0 0.908, vx0 0.737) was oracle integration error at the non-smooth penumbra RHS: it scaled with rtol and did not change with quadrature dt

defects.title: Stale optical docstring references a nonexistent script
defects.root_cause: docstring named examples/phase17_r1o_opt_light_time.py, which never existed
defects.effect: documentation only
defects.repair: now cites examples/phase17_r1o_opt_oracles.py and OPTICAL_LIGHT_TIME_SIGNIFICANCE

defects.title: R2 provenance gate: NameError + stale dynamics.py hash
defects.discovered: Phase 17-HARDEN (pre-existing full-suite non-pass: 1 failure + 10 cascading fixture errors)
defects.root_cause: the qualified R2 gate hashed lunar_od/dynamics.py against its R2-closure value d0f7ab02 although commit 0e785f6 (authorised SRP-gradient documentation) legitimately changed the file; a loop referenced an undefined name
defects.effect: R2 fidelity suite unrunnable (10 errors); no scientific effect
defects.repair: documented re-freeze PHASE17_HARDEN_REFROZEN_CURRENT_TREE_SHA256 (old d0f7ab02 @ fc13cc4 -> new b369899a, authorising commit 0e785f6, blob c973822f); NameError fixed

defects.title: Anchor-convention check uses next-grid rotation for station B and a frozen Earth
defects.root_cause: station B placed with the transform of the following grid epoch; Earth frozen at t=0
defects.effect: its 'anchor immaterial' conclusion is not trustworthy; no current result depends on it (D2 uses MEASUREMENT_EPOCH)
defects.repair: script refuses to run without PHASE17_LEGACY_REPRODUCTION=1

defects.title: Cross-worktree import leak (FA-06)
defects.root_cause: the worktree had no pytest.ini, so pytest used the workspace ini whose pythonpath imported lunar_od from another checkout
defects.effect: tests could exercise a different checkout's production code
defects.repair: worktree-local pytest.ini (no pythonpath) + tests/conftest.py pinning ROOT and desktop_app

defects.title: Machine-specific absolute paths
defects.root_cause: paths hard-coded per session; two pointed at the repo only through the Grad junction
defects.effect: non-portable; silently resolves to another checkout if the junction moves
defects.repair: lunar_od/project_paths.py (env-overridable LUNAR_OD_PROJECT_ROOT / _CAMPAIGN_ROOT / _GRAVITY_ROOT) and repo-relative artifacts paths; zero literals remain in tracked .py outside archive/

defects.title: Orphan R1O-D scripts importing nonexistent functions
defects.root_cause: written against a pre-1045898 delta_dor API (delta_dor_k_column, spacecraft_differential_delay)
defects.effect: fail on import; outputs superseded or nonexistent
defects.repair: moved byte-for-byte to archive/phase17_orphans with README and SHA-256 manifest (LF hashes match the hygiene report)

defects.title: External campaign module prepends a sibling checkout to sys.path
defects.discovered: Phase 17-HARDEN (caught by the new import-isolation test)
defects.root_cause: sys.path.insert(0, '<...>/python_port_grail_pines_20260813') before 'from lunar_od ...'
defects.effect: latent: that directory does not exist today so nothing was rebound; if recreated, the campaign (and every later importer) would bind lunar_od from another checkout
defects.repair: lunar_od.project_paths.import_campaign_module(): binds lunar_od to this repo first, strips foreign python_port* entries, verifies the campaign's lunar_od objects come from this repo; used by phase17_r1m_core and tests/conftest.py. The external file is not modified (outside scope).

defects.title: bridge_reduced_rows: frozen Earth and elevation-only visibility (used by FXR)
defects.root_cause: R1O-D's reduced bridge placed stations on an Earth frozen at t=0
defects.effect: FXR 'bridge_surrogate_5nrad' row is historical only
defects.repair: always emits SupersededVisibilityWarning; documented historical-only; no visibility-correct variant by design

defects.title: Production range generator accepts untagged Earth callables
defects.root_cause: Earth providers are bare callables with no epoch/frame/unit metadata
defects.effect: the FXR epoch offset passed silently
defects.repair: contract layer lunar_od/measurement_contracts.py (the frozen module is not edited; a first attempt that edited it tripped the P21-M3 byte gate and was reverted): tagged providers are validated (epoch/frame/centre/units); every provider must give a physical Moon-Earth distance (catches km/m and wrong body); direct calls from scenarios.py / Phase-17 code are forbidden by test. Residual: an untagged callable with a wrong epoch but physical distance is still accepted; all Phase-17 science builders pass tagged providers (tested)

defects.title: MoonCenteredEphemeris extrapolated PCHIP silently outside its samples
defects.root_cause: scipy PchipInterpolator extrapolates by default
defects.effect: unbounded ephemeris error outside the sampled span
defects.repair: EphemerisCoverageError beyond a 10 s margin

defects.title: ΔDOR sensitivity accepted a transmit epoch before the trajectory grid
defects.root_cause: state/STM interpolation extrapolated linearly and silently
defects.effect: none in committed results (no D2/FXR row at grid index 0)
defects.repair: DeltaDorEventError outside [t_grid[0], t_grid[-1]]; station B receive up to ~0.03 s past the last node remains a bounded (~1e-5 m) extrapolation
defects.regression: tests/test_harden_boundaries.py light-time; R1O-D2 contract tests unchanged

defects.title: Optical K-sensitivity accepted a flat/non-6x6 STM block
defects.root_cause: no shape check; a flat [6:42] row could be reshaped in the wrong order by a caller
defects.effect: none observed
defects.repair: raises unless phi.shape == (6, 6)

defects.title: Numba ephemeris lerp extrapolates beyond its grid
defects.root_cause: binary-search lerp uses the edge interval for out-of-grid t
defects.effect: bounded in current use (propagation grids cover the arc); unbounded in principle
defects.repair: not modified: accelerated.py is R2-protected

defects.title: Unbounded linear extrapolation helpers in radiometrics/filters
defects.root_cause: edge branch extrapolates linearly without a bound (filters also interpolates rotation matrices linearly)
defects.effect: Phase-17 uses are bounded: ΔDOR t_tx now guarded (D16), t_B <= ~0.03 s past grid (~1e-5 m); filters path is not used by Phase-17 science
defects.repair: route through lunar_od/history_domain bounds in a later phase

defects.title: Legacy analyze_visibility_gap carries three time origins; VisibilityConfig.epoch_utc redundant on the transform path
defects.root_cause: legacy MATLAB-port API (GST from epoch_utc, Earth callable in scenario seconds, transforms from et0)
defects.effect: none on the transform path used by Phase 17 (epoch_utc unused there)
defects.repair: Phase-17 code uses only the transform path via station_visibility_mask (epoch_utc='UNUSED_BY_THE_TRANSFORM_PATH')

defects.title: earth_position_mci counts seconds from the campaign epoch implicitly
defects.root_cause: helper takes campaign seconds without an explicit origin argument
defects.effect: none (all callers use campaign seconds; FXR audited)

defects.title: Range residuals below 1e-7 m zeroed
defects.root_cause: synthetic-closure round-off suppression
defects.effect: cosmetic; 1e-7 m << any noise level

defects.root_cause: documented design choice
